notes: The glosses «- يعني ابن زريع -» and «- وهو ابن القاسم -» are left out, so the names are the bare يزيد and روح as written. The pronoun «سمعه وهو» (occurrence 2 of هو) is the person Ata heard; it is kept as a back_reference.

needs_ruling: «يحدث أبا صالح» names Abu Salih only as the one told, and the text does not give him as a link; the Kitab's own sequence does. Not added. This is the one place the reading and the claimed chain differ.

fixes.reason: The text names Abu Salih only as the addressee of the narration, while the K6 sequence places him as a link between Ata and Tamim.

evidence.quote: يحدث أبا صالح عن تميم الداري
